changelog: Status can now be set to anything, in any direction — no more blocking errors. Design Approved and Ready for Print no longer wait for the customer's online approval, and a job can be moved from the first stage to the last or from the last back to the first.

A mis-click is now recoverable: an order set to Completed, Delivered or Cancelled by mistake can be put straight back to Design Pending from the orders list, and the delivered/completed/cancelled marks are cleared with it.
The status dropdown now shows on every order, including completed and cancelled ones, and no reason is required to move a job backwards.
The “Customer approved in person” tick still exists but is no longer needed to proceed — it simply records that the customer approved face to face.
